```{r setup, include=FALSE}
required_pkgs <- c(
  "shiny", "bslib", "readxl", "dplyr", "tidyr", "stringr", "purrr",
  "DT", "ggplot2", "glue", "tibble", "tools"
)

missing_pkgs <- required_pkgs[!vapply(required_pkgs, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)]
if (length(missing_pkgs) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Please install required packages before running this app: ",
    paste(missing_pkgs, collapse = ", "),
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

lapply(required_pkgs, library, character.only = TRUE)
options(shiny.maxRequestSize = 30 * 1024^2)

DEFAULT_WORKBOOK <- "RDCD_Data_Source_Preparation_Template.xlsx"

`%||%` <- function(x, y) {
  if (is.null(x) || length(x) == 0) y else x
}

clean_names <- function(x) {
  x |>
    stringr::str_replace_all("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_") |>
    stringr::str_replace_all("_+$", "") |>
    stringr::str_replace_all("^_+", "") |>
    tolower()
}

as_text <- function(x) {
  x <- ifelse(is.na(x), "", as.character(x))
  stringr::str_squish(x)
}

split_terms <- function(x) {
  if (is.null(x) || length(x) == 0) return(character())
  x <- paste(x, collapse = " ")
  terms <- stringr::str_split(tolower(x), "[,;\\n\\r]+|\\s+and\\s+|\\s+or\\s+")[[1]]
  terms <- stringr::str_squish(terms)
  terms <- terms[nchar(terms) >= 3]
  unique(terms)
}

extract_words <- function(x) {
  if (is.null(x) || length(x) == 0) return(character())
  stop_words <- c(
    "the", "and", "for", "with", "from", "this", "that", "into", "data", "source",
    "sources", "study", "research", "health", "using", "want", "need", "look", "about",
    "interest", "interested", "outcome", "outcomes"
  )
  words <- stringr::str_split(tolower(paste(x, collapse = " ")), "[^a-z0-9]+")[[1]]
  words <- words[nchar(words) >= 3]
  unique(words[!words %in% stop_words])
}

#part of 7/9 fix for search_terms change


contains_any <- function(text, terms) {
  if (length(terms) == 0) return(rep(FALSE, length(text)))
  purrr::map_lgl(text, function(txt) {
    any(stringr::str_detect(txt, stringr::fixed(terms, ignore_case = TRUE)))
  })
}

count_term_hits <- function(text, terms) {
  if (length(terms) == 0) return(rep(0, length(text)))
  purrr::map_int(text, function(txt) {
    sum(stringr::str_detect(txt, stringr::fixed(terms, ignore_case = TRUE)))
  })
}

# matched_terms <- function(text, terms, max_terms = 12) {
#   if (length(terms) == 0) return("")
#   hits <- terms[stringr::str_detect(text, stringr::fixed(terms, ignore_case = TRUE))]
#   paste(head(unique(hits), max_terms), collapse = "; ")
# }

find_matched_terms <- function(text, terms, max_terms = 12) {
  if (length(terms) == 0 || is.null(text) || length(text) == 0) return("")

  txt <- tolower(paste(text, collapse = " "))

  hits <- terms[vapply(
    terms,
    function(term) stringr::str_detect(txt, stringr::fixed(term, ignore_case = TRUE)),
    logical(1)
  )]

  paste(head(unique(hits), max_terms), collapse = "; ")
}

safe_col <- function(df, nm, default = "") {
  if (nm %in% names(df)) as_text(df[[nm]]) else rep(default, nrow(df))
}

standardize_access_burden <- function(access_level, access_burden) {
  existing <- as_text(access_burden)
  access <- tolower(as_text(access_level))
  inferred <- dplyr::case_when(
    stringr::str_detect(access, "open/public") & !stringr::str_detect(access, "restricted|controlled|credentialed|purchased") ~ "Low",
    stringr::str_detect(access, "registered public-use|public-use plus restricted|registered/controlled|open plus credentialed|open plus controlled|terms") ~ "Medium",
    stringr::str_detect(access, "controlled|restricted|credentialed|purchased") ~ "High",
    TRUE ~ "Unknown"
  )
  ifelse(nchar(existing) > 0, existing, inferred)
}

infer_data_type <- function(text) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    stringr::str_detect(text, "survey|surveys|questionnaire|household|behavioral risk") ~ "Survey",
    stringr::str_detect(text, "registry|surveillance|incidence|mortality|prevalence|vital statistics") ~ "Registry/surveillance",
    stringr::str_detect(text, "claims|medicare|medicaid|payment|cost|expenditure|insurance|provider|enrollment") ~ "Claims/payment",
    stringr::str_detect(text, "ehr|electronic health record|clinical|hospital|icu|encounter|diagnosis|laboratory|medication") ~ "EHR/clinical",
    stringr::str_detect(text, "cohort|longitudinal|follow-up|retirement|aging") ~ "Cohort/longitudinal",
    stringr::str_detect(text, "county|tract|zip|zcta|geographic|geospatial|census|vulnerability|rural") ~ "Geospatial/area-level",
    stringr::str_detect(text, "environment|air quality|water|hazardous|toxic|exposure|heat") ~ "Environmental",
    stringr::str_detect(text, "genom|genotype|phenotype|gene expression|molecular|transcriptomics|biospecimen") ~ "Genomics/molecular",
    stringr::str_detect(text, "imaging|radiology|pathology|mri|ct|dicom") ~ "Imaging",
    stringr::str_detect(text, "physiologic|ecg|waveform") ~ "Physiologic signals",
    stringr::str_detect(text, "clinical trial|trial registry|intervention|sponsor") ~ "Trial registry",
    stringr::str_detect(text, "synthetic") ~ "Synthetic data",
    TRUE ~ "Other"
  )
}

  "Claims",

  "cms|resdac|claims|medicare|medicaid|meps",
  25, 10,

  "Environment",

  "epa|tracking|air quality|environment",

  "acs|svi|county health rankings|food environment",
  20, 8

score_concepts <- function(query_text, source_text, rules = concept_rules) {
  query_text <- tolower(query_text)
  source_text <- tolower(source_text)

  boost_total <- 0
  penalty_total <- 0

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(rules))) {
    query_hit <- stringr::str_detect(query_text, stringr::regex(rules$query_pattern[i], ignore_case = TRUE))
    source_hit <- stringr::str_detect(source_text, stringr::regex(rules$source_pattern[i], ignore_case = TRUE))

    if (isTRUE(query_hit) && isTRUE(source_hit)) {
      boost_total <- boost_total + rules$boost[i]
    }

    if (isTRUE(query_hit) && !isTRUE(source_hit)) {
      penalty_total <- penalty_total + rules$penalty[i]
    }
  }

  list(boost = boost_total, penalty = penalty_total)
}

load_catalog <- function(path) {
  if (!file.exists(path)) {
    return(tibble::tribble(
      ~record_id, ~data_source, ~official_link_text, ~official_url, ~main_data_type_use, ~raw_access_level,
      "DS-017", "CDC PLACES", "PLACES Data Portal", "https://www.cdc.gov/places/", "County, city, census tract, and ZIP-level chronic disease and health behavior estimates", "Open/public",
      "DS-018", "CDC/ATSDR Social Vulnerability Index - SVI", "SVI Data Download", "https://www.atsdr.cdc.gov/place-health/php/svi/", "County and census tract social vulnerability measures", "Open/public",
      "DS-019", "U.S. Census American Community Survey - ACS", "ACS API", "https://www.census.gov/programs-surveys/acs/data/data-via-api.html", "Demographic, socioeconomic, housing, insurance, education, employment variables", "Open/public",
      "DS-047", "USDA Food Environment Atlas", "USDA Food Environment Atlas", "https://www.ers.usda.gov/data-products/food-environment-atlas", "County food access, food stores, restaurants, assistance programs, local foods", "Open/public",
      "DS-053", "South Carolina DPH Public Health Data", "SC DPH Public Health Data", "https://dph.sc.gov/professionals/public-health-data", "South Carolina public health dashboards, reports, BRFSS, cancer registry, HIV/STD, overdose, vital statistics resources", "Open/public plus restricted components"
    ))
  }

  raw <- readxl::read_excel(path, sheet = "Data_Prep") |>
    dplyr::rename_with(clean_names) |>
    dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(dplyr::everything(), as_text))

 needed <- c(
  "record_id", "data_source", "official_link_text", "official_url", "main_data_type_use", "raw_access_level",
  "access_level_standardized", "access_burden", "primary_category", "secondary_categories_tags",
  "keywords_for_search", "data_type_standardized", "topic_area_s", "population", "geography_coverage",
  "geographic_unit", "unit_of_analysis", "individual_level_data", "area_level_data", "longitudinal",
  "years_available", "refresh_frequency", "linkage_potential", "south_carolina_relevance",
  "common_variables_measures", "suggested_use_cases", "companion_datasets", "limitations_cautions",
  "data_governance_notes", "rdcd_consultation_notes", "demo_include", "priority", "status",
  "app_search_text"
)
  for (nm in needed) if (!nm %in% names(raw)) raw[[nm]] <- ""
  raw[, needed]
}

prepare_catalog <- function(df) {
  df <- df |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      access_level_standardized = dplyr::if_else(
        nchar(access_level_standardized) > 0,
        access_level_standardized,
        raw_access_level
      ),
     search_text = tolower(paste(
  data_source,
  official_link_text,
  main_data_type_use,
  raw_access_level,
  access_level_standardized,
  primary_category,
  secondary_categories_tags,
  keywords_for_search,
  data_type_standardized,
  topic_area_s,
  population,
  geography_coverage,
  geographic_unit,
  unit_of_analysis,
  common_variables_measures,
  suggested_use_cases,
  companion_datasets,
  limitations_cautions,
  data_governance_notes,
  rdcd_consultation_notes,
  app_search_text,
  sep = " "
)),
      concept_text = tolower(paste(
        primary_category,
        secondary_categories_tags,
        keywords_for_search,
        common_variables_measures,
        suggested_use_cases,
        companion_datasets,
        limitations_cautions,
        rdcd_consultation_notes,
        sep = " "
      )),
      category_for_filter = dplyr::if_else(
        nchar(primary_category) > 0,
        primary_category,
        ""
      ),
      data_type_for_filter = dplyr::if_else(
        nchar(data_type_standardized) > 0,
        data_type_standardized,
        infer_data_type(search_text)
      ),
      access_burden_for_filter = standardize_access_burden(access_level_standardized, access_burden),
      official_url = dplyr::if_else(nchar(official_url) > 0, official_url, NA_character_)
    )
  df
}



score_catalog <- function(df, terms, category_filter, data_type_filter, geography_filter, access_filter, open_only) {
  if (nrow(df) == 0) return(df)

  query_text <- tolower(paste(terms, collapse = " "))

  term_hits <- count_term_hits(df$search_text, terms)
  max_hit_denominator <- max(1, min(10, length(terms)))
  keyword_score <- pmin(40, round(40 * term_hits / max_hit_denominator, 1))

  concept_score <- purrr::map_dbl(df$concept_text, function(src) {
    fit <- score_concepts(query_text, src)
    fit$boost - fit$penalty
  })
  concept_score <- pmax(0, concept_score)
  concept_hit <- concept_score > 0

  category_score <- if (length(category_filter) == 0) {
    rep(0, nrow(df))
  } else {
    ifelse(contains_any(df$category_for_filter, category_filter), 20, 0)
  }

  data_type_score <- if (length(data_type_filter) == 0) {
    rep(0, nrow(df))
  } else {
    ifelse(contains_any(df$data_type_for_filter, data_type_filter), 15, 0)
  }

  geography_text <- tolower(paste(
    df$geography_coverage,
    df$geographic_unit,
    df$main_data_type_use,
    df$data_source,
    sep = " "
  ))
  geography_terms <- geography_filter_terms(geography_filter)
  geography_score <- if (length(geography_filter) == 0) {
    rep(0, nrow(df))
  } else {
    ifelse(contains_any(geography_text, geography_terms), 15, 0)
  }

  access_score <- ifelse(df$access_burden_for_filter == "Low", 3,
                         ifelse(df$access_burden_for_filter == "Medium", 2,
                                ifelse(df$access_burden_for_filter == "High", 1, 0)))

  linkage_score <- ifelse(tolower(df$linkage_potential) == "high", 3,
                          ifelse(tolower(df$linkage_potential) == "medium", 2, 0))

  matched_terms_text <- purrr::map_chr(df$search_text, ~ find_matched_terms(.x, terms))

  raw_score <- keyword_score + concept_score + category_score + data_type_score +
  geography_score + access_score + linkage_score

  out <- df |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      keyword_hits = term_hits,
      concept_score = round(concept_score, 1),
      concept_hit = concept_hit,
      matched_terms = matched_terms_text,
      match_score = round(pmax(0, pmin(100, raw_score)), 1),
      why_matched = paste0(
        "Matched terms: ", matched_terms_text,
        ". Concept fit: ", round(concept_score, 1),
        ". Category: ", category_for_filter,
        ". Access: ", access_level_standardized,
        "."
      )
    )

  if (length(access_filter) > 0) {
    out <- out |> dplyr::filter(contains_any(access_level_standardized, access_filter))
  }

  if (isTRUE(open_only)) {
    out <- out |>
      dplyr::filter(
        access_burden_for_filter == "Low" |
          stringr::str_detect(tolower(access_level_standardized), "open|public")
      )
  }

  out |>
    dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(match_score), dplyr::desc(keyword_hits), data_source)
}

make_html_link <- function(label, url) {
  ifelse(
    is.na(url) | nchar(url) == 0,
    label,
    sprintf('<a href="%s" target="_blank">%s</a>', url, label)
  )
}

normalize_geography_token <- function(x) {
  x <- tolower(as_text(x))
  x <- stringr::str_squish(x)
  if (length(x) == 0 || nchar(x) == 0 || x %in% c("other", "unknown", "n/a", "na")) return(character())

  dplyr::case_when(
    stringr::str_detect(x, "south carolina|^sc$") ~ "South Carolina",
    stringr::str_detect(x, "global|international|country") ~ "Global/international",
    stringr::str_detect(x, "united states|^us$|^u\\.s\\.?$|national") ~ "United States",
    stringr::str_detect(x, "census tract|tract") ~ "Census tract",
    stringr::str_detect(x, "block group") ~ "Census block group",
    stringr::str_detect(x, "zip|zcta") ~ "ZIP/ZCTA",
    stringr::str_detect(x, "county") ~ "County-level",
    stringr::str_detect(x, "state") ~ "State-level",
    stringr::str_detect(x, "city") ~ "City",
    stringr::str_detect(x, "hospital|health system|facility|provider") ~ "Hospital/provider",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  ) |>
    stats::na.omit() |>
    as.character()
}

geography_filter_choices <- function(df) {
  raw_values <- c(safe_col(df, "geography_coverage"), safe_col(df, "geographic_unit"))
  raw_tokens <- unlist(stringr::str_split(raw_values, "[,;/\\n\\r]+|\\s+and\\s+|\\s+or\\s+"))
  normalized <- unique(unlist(purrr::map(raw_tokens, normalize_geography_token)))
  normalized <- sort(normalized[nchar(normalized) > 0])
  unique(c(DEFAULT_GEO, normalized))
}

geography_filter_terms <- function(filters) {
  if (length(filters) == 0) return(character())
  terms <- purrr::map(filters, function(filter) {
    dplyr::case_when(
      filter == "United States" ~ "united states; us; u.s.; national",
      filter == "South Carolina" ~ "south carolina; sc",
      filter == "Global/international" ~ "global; international; country",
      filter == "State-level" ~ "state; state-level",
      filter == "County-level" ~ "county; county-level",
      filter == "Census tract" ~ "census tract; tract",
      filter == "Census block group" ~ "census block group; block group",
      filter == "ZIP/ZCTA" ~ "zip; zip code; zcta",
      filter == "City" ~ "city",
      filter == "Hospital/provider" ~ "hospital; health system; facility; provider",
      TRUE ~ filter
    )
  }) |>
    unlist() |>
    split_terms()
  unique(terms)
}
```

```{r ui, echo=FALSE}
    tags$script(HTML("
      function syncRdcdPanelHeights() {
        var left = document.querySelector('.rdcd-app .sidebarPanel');
        var right = document.querySelector('.rdcd-app .mainPanel');
        if (!left || !right) return;

        left.style.height = 'auto';
        right.style.height = 'auto';

        var h = Math.max(left.offsetHeight, right.offsetHeight);
        left.style.height = h + 'px';
        right.style.height = h + 'px';
      }

      $(document).on('shiny:recalculated', syncRdcdPanelHeights);
      $(window).on('resize', syncRdcdPanelHeights);
      $(document).on('shiny:connected', syncRdcdPanelHeights);
    "))
  ),

  div(
    class = "rdcd-app",

    div(
      class = "rdcd-header",
      h1("RDCD Public Data Discovery Navigator"),
      div(class = "subtitle", "University of South Carolina • Research Design & Data Coordination Core")
```

## 5. Server logic

```{r server, context="server"}
current_path <- reactive({
  if (!is.null(input$catalog_file)) {
    input$catalog_file$datapath
  } else {
    DEFAULT_WORKBOOK
  }
})

raw_catalog <- reactive({
  load_catalog(current_path())
})

processed_catalog <- reactive({
  prepare_catalog(raw_catalog())
})

observe({
  df <- processed_catalog()
  category_choices <- unique(c(DEFAULT_CATEGORIES, split_terms(df$category_for_filter)))
  category_choices <- sort(category_choices[nchar(category_choices) > 0])
  data_type_choices <- unique(c(DEFAULT_DATA_TYPES, df$data_type_for_filter))
  data_type_choices <- sort(data_type_choices[nchar(data_type_choices) > 0])
  geography_choices <- geography_filter_choices(df)
  access_choices <- unique(c(DEFAULT_ACCESS, df$access_level_standardized))
  access_choices <- sort(access_choices[nchar(access_choices) > 0])

  updateSelectizeInput(session, "category_filter", choices = category_choices, server = TRUE)
  updateSelectizeInput(session, "data_type_filter", choices = data_type_choices, server = TRUE)
  updateSelectizeInput(session, "geography_filter", choices = geography_choices, server = TRUE)
  updateSelectizeInput(session, "access_filter", choices = access_choices, server = TRUE)
})



search_terms <- reactive({
  unique(c(
    extract_words(input$question),
    split_terms(input$keyword_string)
  )) |>
    (\(x) x[nchar(x) >= 3])()
})

scored_results <- reactive({
  score_catalog(
    df = processed_catalog(),
    terms = search_terms(),
    category_filter = input$category_filter %||% character(),
    data_type_filter = input$data_type_filter %||% character(),
    geography_filter = input$geography_filter %||% character(),
    access_filter = input$access_filter %||% character(),
    open_only = input$open_only
  ) |>
    dplyr::filter(match_score >= input$min_score)
})
output$result_summary <- renderUI({
  df <- scored_results()
  tagList(
    tags$p(
      tags$span(class = "metric", nrow(df)), " data sources meet the current criteria. ",
      tags$span(class = "metric", length(search_terms())), " search terms used."
    ),
    tags$p(class = "small-note", paste("Search terms:", paste(search_terms(), collapse = ", ")))
  )
})

output$results_table <- DT::renderDT({
  df <- scored_results() |>
    dplyr::slice_head(n = input$top_n) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      Rank = dplyr::row_number(),
      link = make_html_link(official_link_text, official_url)
    ) |>
    dplyr::select(
  Rank,
  `Data Source` = data_source,
  `Match Score` = match_score,
  `Access` = access_level_standardized,
  `Category` = category_for_filter,
  `Data Type` = data_type_for_filter,
  `Official Link` = link
)

  DT::datatable(
    df,
    escape = FALSE,
    rownames = FALSE,
    filter = "top",
    options = list(pageLength = 10, scrollX = TRUE, autoWidth = TRUE)
  )
})

output$source_cards <- renderUI({
  df <- scored_results() |> dplyr::slice_head(n = min(10, input$top_n))
  if (nrow(df) == 0) return(tags$p("No data sources meet the current criteria."))

  tagList(purrr::map(seq_len(nrow(df)), function(i) {
    row <- df[i, ]
    tags$div(
      class = "data-card",
      tags$h4(paste0(i, ". ", row$data_source, " - ", row$match_score, "% match")),
      tags$p(tags$b("Access: "), row$access_level_standardized, " | ", tags$b("Burden: "), row$access_burden_for_filter),
      tags$p(tags$b("Category: "), row$category_for_filter),
      tags$p(tags$b("Data type: "), row$data_type_for_filter),
      tags$p(tags$b("Main use: "), row$main_data_type_use),
      tags$p(tags$b("Why it matched: "), row$why_matched),
      if (!is.na(row$official_url) && nchar(row$official_url) > 0) {
        tags$a(href = row$official_url, target = "_blank", "Open official source")
      } else {
        tags$span(class = "small-note", "No URL provided in the source file.")
      }
    )
  }))
})

output$compare_picker <- renderUI({
  df <- scored_results()
  selectizeInput(
    "compare_sources",
    "Choose 2-5 sources to compare",
    choices = df$data_source,
    selected = head(df$data_source, 3),
    multiple = TRUE
  )
})

output$compare_table <- DT::renderDT({
  selected <- input$compare_sources %||% character()
  df <- scored_results() |>
    dplyr::filter(data_source %in% selected) |>
    dplyr::select(
      `Data Source` = data_source,
      `Match Score` = match_score,
      `Access` = access_level_standardized,
      `Access Burden` = access_burden_for_filter,
      `Category` = category_for_filter,
      `Data Type` = data_type_for_filter,
      `Population` = population,
      `Geography` = geography_coverage,
      `Unit` = unit_of_analysis,
      `Years` = years_available,
      `Linkage Potential` = linkage_potential,
      `SC Relevance` = south_carolina_relevance,
      `Limitations` = limitations_cautions
    )

  DT::datatable(df, rownames = FALSE, options = list(pageLength = 5, scrollX = TRUE, autoWidth = TRUE))
})

output$score_plot <- renderPlot({
  df <- scored_results() |>
    dplyr::slice_head(n = min(15, input$top_n))
  validate(need(nrow(df) > 0, "No results to plot."))
  ggplot(df, aes(x = reorder(data_source, match_score), y = match_score)) +
    geom_col() +
    coord_flip() +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Match score", title = "Top data source matches") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
})

output$category_plot <- renderPlot({
  df <- scored_results() |>
    tidyr::separate_rows(category_for_filter, sep = ";") |>
    dplyr::mutate(category_for_filter = stringr::str_squish(category_for_filter)) |>
    dplyr::filter(nchar(category_for_filter) > 0) |>
    dplyr::count(category_for_filter, sort = TRUE) |>
    dplyr::slice_head(n = 15)
  validate(need(nrow(df) > 0, "No categories to plot."))
  ggplot(df, aes(x = reorder(category_for_filter, n), y = n)) +
    geom_col() +
    coord_flip() +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Number of matching sources", title = "Category distribution among current results") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
})

data_fit_summary <- reactive({
  df <- scored_results() |> dplyr::slice_head(n = 6)
  if (nrow(df) == 0) return("No data sources meet the current criteria. Try broadening keywords or lowering the minimum score.")

  top <- df[1, ]
  companions <- df |> dplyr::slice(2:min(6, nrow(df))) |> dplyr::pull(data_source)
  companion_text <- if (length(companions) > 0) paste(companions, collapse = "; ") else "None identified in the current search."

  paste0(
    "RDCD DATA FIT SUMMARY\n",
    "=====================\n\n",
    "Research question / concept:\n", input$question, "\n\n",
    "Keywords used:\n", paste(search_terms(), collapse = ", "), "\n\n",
    "Recommended primary source:\n", top$data_source, " (", top$match_score, "% match)\n",
    "Access level: ", top$access_level_standardized, "\n",
    "Access burden: ", top$access_burden_for_filter, "\n",
    "Category: ", top$category_for_filter, "\n",
    "Data type: ", top$data_type_for_filter, "\n",
    "Main use: ", top$main_data_type_use, "\n\n",
    "Suggested companion sources:\n", companion_text, "\n\n",
    "Why this source fits:\n", top$why_matched, "\n\n",
    "Suggested next RDCD step:\n",
    "Confirm the outcome, exposure, population, geography, years, access requirements, and analytic unit before moving to analysis planning or formal data request.\n\n",
    "Caution:\n",
    "This tool supports triage and feasibility review. It does not replace IRB, DUA, data governance, or source-specific access review."
  )
})

output$fit_summary <- renderUI({
  txt <- data_fit_summary()

  if (is.null(txt) || !nzchar(txt)) {
    return(div(class = "fit-summary-callout", p("No summary available yet.")))
  }

  div(
    class = "fit-summary-shell",

    div(
      class = "fit-summary-hero",
      div(class = "fit-summary-kicker", "AI-assisted recommendation"),
      h3("Data Fit Recommendation"),
      p(
        class = "fit-summary-lead",
        "A concise summary of the best-fit source(s), access path, and next RDCD step."
      )
    ),

    div(
      class = "fit-summary-callout",
      tags$pre(class = "fit-summary-pre", txt)
    )
  )
})

output$download_results <- downloadHandler(
  filename = function() {
    paste0("rdcd_data_source_matches_", Sys.Date(), ".csv")
  },
  content = function(file) {
    scored_results() |>
      dplyr::select(
        record_id, data_source, match_score, official_url, main_data_type_use,
        access_level_standardized, access_burden_for_filter, category_for_filter,
        data_type_for_filter, geography_coverage, why_matched
      ) |>
      utils::write.csv(file, row.names = FALSE)
  }
)

output$download_summary <- downloadHandler(
  filename = function() {
    paste0("rdcd_data_fit_summary_", Sys.Date(), ".txt")
  },
  content = function(file) {
    writeLines(data_fit_summary(), file)
  }
)
```
